block.intro: Three reasons you can paste into a capital request, with the Health Canada source where one applies.

items.d: In liquids and creams, water is an ingredient. Water made and tested to a written specification protects your limits and shelf life.
Health Canada's good manufacturing practice guides ask for qualified, monitored water and its test records. GUI-0001 covers drugs; GUI-0158, natural health products.
The package is sized to the water your products use each day. Adding lines later is a capacity upgrade.
